verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents browser actions (click, wait, scroll) that run before scraping, with checks on which actions succeeded. Its screenshot endpoint can handle overlays. Both could help an agent dismiss simple interstitials, but nothing documents CAPTCHA solving, automated login, form filling, or anti-bot bypass, and community questions about proxies go unanswered. Missing for 10: CAPTCHA solving, authenticated login/session handling, form input/typing actions, anti-bot/proxy evidence, hands-on corroboration.
